name: get_case_state
description: Get an ERP exception case from DynamoDB by its case_id. The case_id is given to you in the prompt; it has the form {document_number}-{item_id} (for AP: supplier invoice number and fiscal year).

name: update_case_state
description: Update an ERP exception case fields (status, amounts, dates, etc.).

updates.description: JSON string of fields to update (e.g. {"status": "processing", "exception_type": "PRICE"}). `updated_at`, `action_log` and `inquiry_sent_at` are recorded automatically; any value you send for them is discarded.
